name: Pregonero
desc_en: Hunched town crier of a cursed city, ragged coat, raising a cracked brass bell and a torn proclamation scroll, shouting to a crowd behind him

name: Barricadista
desc_en: Stocky cursed-city citizen in patched leather apron dragging a barricade of broken doors, carts and planks, holding a crowbar

name: Capitana de la Guardia
desc_en: Weathered city guard captain in dented steel breastplate and tattered tabard, halberd raised, rallying a line of ragged militia at night

name: Cristal Fragmentado
desc_en: Small floating cluster of cracked amber crystal shards held together by a glowing core, sparks leaking from the fractures, mine tunnel background

name: Horno de Cristal
desc_en: Squat walking furnace-golem of riveted iron with a glass belly full of molten crystal, pouring out tiny crystal servants from a spout

name: Coloso de Cuarzo
desc_en: Towering golem made of violet and white quartz pillars, glowing seams, shoulders covered in crystal growths, deep mine cavern

name: Lobezno
desc_en: Scrappy brown wolf cub with oversized paws, snarling, leaves in its fur, mossy forest floor

name: Jabalí Musgoso
desc_en: Huge wild boar with moss and small ferns growing on its back, tusks wrapped in roots, charging through a misty forest

name: Druida de los Hongos
desc_en: Old druid with a cloak of layered mushroom caps and a staff topped by a glowing fungus, releasing soft green healing spores

name: Trampero
desc_en: Wiry labyrinth trapper in sand-colored hood, belt of ropes, snares and bear traps, crouching beside a pressure plate in stone corridors

name: Minotauro Joven
desc_en: Young minotaur with short horns and bronze nose ring, wielding a broken column as a club, sandstone labyrinth walls

name: Espíritu Glacial
desc_en: Small translucent ice spirit shaped like a wisp with a frosty face, trailing snowflakes, frozen lake background

name: Anguila de Escarcha
desc_en: Long pale-blue eel with frost-covered fins and icicle teeth, coiling out of a hole in thick sea ice

name: Sirena Abisal
desc_en: Abyssal siren with dark scales and bioluminescent fins, singing, frost forming on the water around her, deep cold sea

name: Calavera Ardiente
desc_en: Floating human skull wreathed in orange flames, cracked bone, embers trailing, infernal crypt background

name: Aprendiz de Nigromante
desc_en: Young necromancer apprentice in oversized black robes, nervously raising a bony hand while a skeleton claws out of the ground

name: Caballero de Hueso
desc_en: Skeletal knight in rusted black armor riding a skeletal horse, tattered banner, lance of bone, crypt fog

name: Hongo Saltarín
desc_en: Small hopping purple mushroom creature with stubby legs and a mischievous face, puffing spores as it lands, mycelium forest

name: Esporero
desc_en: Swarm of tiny glowing spore-sprites carrying a pulsing green puffball, leaving a poisonous mist, fungal kingdom background

name: Micelio Vivo
desc_en: Living wall of tangled white mycelium threads and shelf fungi shaped like a hunched guardian, glowing veins, fungal cavern

name: Reina Micelial
desc_en: Regal queen of the fungal kingdom with a crown of bioluminescent mushrooms, gown of gills and veils of violet spores, throne of giant fungi

name: Clamor de la Turba
desc_en: A furious crowd raising torches, pitchforks and fists in a cursed city square at night

name: Motín
desc_en: Riot in a cursed city street: looters breaking windows, overturned carts, torches, smoke

name: Martillazo
desc_en: Heavy miner's hammer striking glowing crystal ore, shards and sparks flying

name: Pulso Resonante
desc_en: Ring-shaped wave of violet light pulsing outward from a cluster of humming crystals

name: Luna de Caza
desc_en: Huge full moon over a forest clearing, silhouettes of howling wolves and a spectral wolf leaping

name: Plano Secreto
desc_en: Worn parchment map of a labyrinth with hidden passages marked in red ink, compass and candle

name: Aliento Helado
desc_en: Ghostly frosty breath sweeping across, freezing a raised claw in a block of ice

name: Avalancha
desc_en: Massive avalanche of snow and ice crashing down a mountain slope, burying frozen figures

name: Ceniza al Viento
desc_en: Wind carrying burning ash and embers across a crypt graveyard, everything catching fire

name: Nube de Esporas
desc_en: Thick violet cloud of poisonous spores rising from giant mushrooms, figures coughing in the haze

name: Floración Tóxica
desc_en: Explosive bloom of glowing toxic mushrooms bursting from the ground under poisoned creatures

name: Simbiosis
desc_en: Glowing green mycelium threads wrapping around a wounded warrior's arm, healing the wound

name: Turba Enfurecida
desc_en: Ambush in an alley: a looter jumping from a doorway with a club as an invader enters the street

name: Fisura de Cristal
desc_en: Crystal floor cracking open under an attacker's feet, a small crystal servant emerging from the fissure

name: Raíces Atrapantes
desc_en: Thick forest roots bursting from the ground and binding an attacking creature's legs

name: Foso Oculto
desc_en: Hidden pit trap opening in a sandstone labyrinth floor, spikes at the bottom, an attacker falling

name: Galería de Espejos
desc_en: Gallery of tall mirrors in a labyrinth reflecting and freezing a spell back at its caster

name: Hielo Fino
desc_en: Thin ice cracking under an attacker on a frozen lake, freezing water gripping its legs

name: Fosa Común
desc_en: Open mass grave in a crypt where two skeletons climb out as an enemy approaches

name: Estallido de Esporas
desc_en: Giant puffball mushroom exploding into a burst of toxic green spores when stepped on
